explanation: The order_id primary key changed from an integer (dtype "int", samples 1000-1004, range 1000-50999, length 4-5) to a formatted string (dtype "str", samples "ORD-101000"-"ORD-101004", fixed length 10). The file still parses, but any downstream join, lookup, numeric cast, range filter, or max-watermark on order_id silently fails or coerces to NULL because int keys no longer match the "ORD-<n>" string keys, and referential-integrity/dedup checks against history all miss. All other columns (customer_id, customer_name, order_date format, status vocabulary, quantity, unit_price, amount magnitudes/precision, discount_pct, email null rate) are stable within normal day-over-day noise. The accompanying identifier-range shift is expected and not itself drift; the type/format change is the defect.
